Our QC process follows a rigorous 8-Stage Quality Gate Model:

Stage 1 – Incoming Component Inspection:
All components (panels, PCBs, chips, speakers, power supplies, cables, packaging) are tested for electrical performance, reliability, dimensional accuracy, and visual quality. Only certified/approved vendors are used.

Stage 2 – SMT & PCB Assembly Quality Control:
AOI (Automated Optical Inspection), SPI (Solder Paste Inspection), and X-Ray inspection are performed on every board to ensure perfect solder joints, component placement, and board integrity. Faulty boards are flagged and reworked.

Stage 3 – Assembly In-Process Quality Checks:
During panel integration, speaker assembly, and final box-build, continuous inline checks ensure proper fit, alignment, workmanship, and cleanliness. Random samples are pulled for measurement verification.

Stage 4 – Software & Firmware Validation:
Custom Android/Google TV software is loaded, and each unit undergoes full functionality testing – app compatibility, connectivity (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Ethernet), voice control, Chromecast, screen mirroring, and USB/HDMI port functionality.

Stage 5 – Video & Audio Calibration:

Video: Color accuracy, contrast, brightness, uniformity, viewing angle, HDR performance – tested with precision instruments (color analyzers, video pattern generators).

Audio: Frequency response, distortion (THD), signal-to-noise ratio, channel balance, loudness, clarity – tested in dedicated acoustic chambers.

Stage 6 – Burn-in & Reliability Testing:
Every unit undergoes 24–72 hours of continuous operation (burn-in) to detect early failures and ensure long-term reliability. Electrical safety testing (insulation, ground bond, leakage current, hipot) is also performed.

Stage 7 – Final Quality Audit (Cosmetic & Functional):

Cosmetic: Visual check for scratches, dents, gaps, logo/branding quality, accessory completeness.

Functional: Full remote control operation, menu navigation, input switching, audio/video output.

Packaging: Carton strength, foam/cushioning effectiveness, labeling accuracy, tamper-evident seals.

Stage 8 – Dispatch Audit & Traceability:
Random sampling from each batch as per AQL 2.5 (MIL-STD-105E) standards – full visual, functional, and packaging audit. Unique serial numbers assigned to every unit – full traceability records maintained for 5+ years. Complete documentation (COO, Packing List, Test Reports) prepared for export.
